project: Wuxia Life P86 Medical Pressure Design-First
description: Design-first contract for medical_sage_healer pressure stage covering both compassionate and pragmatic variants, with tavern-born healer flavor preserved, handing off a bounded implementation target to P87.

userStories.title: Audit medical pressure prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the medical pressure stage so P86 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing medical route flags, markers, events, and expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp)
Identify what exists before pressure and what can be reused
Analyze pressure prerequisite differences between compassionate and pragmatic variants
Save docs/test-reports/p86-medical-pressure-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Foundational audit — must complete before design begins. Includes 2-variant-specific gap analysis.

userStories.title: Lock P86 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P86 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P86 to gap audit, direction comparison, pressure contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, payoff design
Define boundary with P87 (pressure implementation stage)
Save docs/test-reports/p86-medical-pressure-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope guardrails for the design-first pressure stage — follows P74 renown pattern with 2-variant focus.

userStories.title: Compare medical pressure directions (per variant)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded pressure-direction options for each medical variant so P86 chooses the smallest viable pressure shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compassionate variant: compare at least 2 pressure direction candidates (e.g. burnout / herb shortage / exploited kindness)
Pragmatic variant: compare at least 2 pressure direction candidates (e.g. favors debt / faction siding / fame-vs-profit conflict)
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, tavern-born fit
Clear recommended direction plus dropped directions for each variant
Recommendation follows quality-first and small-step principles
Save comparison document
userStories.notes: Direction selection — 2 variants each with 2+ candidates, choose smallest viable pressure shape per variant.

userStories.title: Define medical pressure contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit pressure contract (2 variants) so P87 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define pressure checkpoint, required flags, and corresponding gate acceptance
Define 1 core pressure event per variant (or 1 tightly coupled small event set each)
Define at least 2 pressure-specific player-facing signals per variant
Clarify difference between pressure vs on-ramp and vs generic midlife
Preserve tavern-born healer flavor (tavern small-clinic background)
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent payoff stage
Continue compassionate / pragmatic differentiation
Record the contract in docs/PRD/p86-medical-pressure-contract.md
userStories.notes: Pressure contract — 2 variants × tavern-born flavor × payoff flag reservation.

userStories.title: Define P87 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P87 validation shape fixed in advance so playable pressure work is judged against explicit proof and regression expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what chain nodes targeted proof must show (on-ramp → pressure → expression changes, both variants)
Define what assertions regression tests must at least cover
Define what evidence counts as pressure closed
Do not require full lifetime exhaust
Define non-regression boundaries for P83/P84/P85 existing evidence
userStories.notes: Pre-commit validation shape for P87 implementation — 2-variant focus.

userStories.title: Produce P86 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the medical pressure design-first contract and hands off a bounded implementation target to P87.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p86-medical-pressure-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, pressure-direction comparison, pressure contract, validation shape
Define clear boundary with P87
List larger medical-expansion items that remain deferred
State whether pressure stage is worth entering implementation (GO / NO-GO)
userStories.notes: Closure and GO/NO-GO for P87 pressure implementation stage.
